info.title: UtgKit.Web - Universal Terminology Governance toolkit (web UI + MCP server
info.description: UTG Kit - toolkit (Blazor UI) for Universal Terminology Governance contributors working with terminology.hl7.org.

options.name: --repo
options.description:
Path to the local THO repo clone. Defaults to the
current working directory if not specified.

options.name: --urls
options.description:
URL(s) the server should listen on
(e.g. http://localhost:5099). Comma-separated.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help text.
Configuration can also be supplied via environment variables (ThoRepo__Path)
or appsettings.json. Command-line values take precedence.
